Mike can ride his bike quite well. Mike likes to ride his bike to sell kites. Mike takes nine kites and a bit of twine. He strings the kites to his bike with the twine. As he rides, the kites go up, up, up. You can see the kites for miles.

slides.text: Mike stops by a red gate and lets the kites wave. “Kites for sale!” he yells. Kids run to his bike. Mike sells his kites for a dime. “Thank you, Mike!” yell the kids as they take their kites.
